breaking_changes: Gradle 8 removes the compile and testCompile configurations used by 15 build files.
jcenter() is unavailable and appears in ten active build files.
Gradle wrapper jumps range from 7.x to 8.10.2 and, for bowlinggame/stringcalculator, from 3.1 to 8.10.2.
sourceCompatibility values 1.10 are malformed for the intended Java level; several other projects omit an explicit source level.
Mockito 2.x to 5.12.0 and Guava 19.0 to 33.2.1-jre are large major-version jumps requiring module-level test validation.
rimraf 5 requires explicit --glob handling for the current npm cleanup scripts.
ts-jest 29 removes the ts-jest/utils subpath used by jest.config.ts; Jest and ts-jest majors must stay aligned.
Chai 5 would switch the Mocha CommonJS setup to ESM, so the requested retained Chai 4 line is a deliberate compatibility constraint.
risk_summary.notes: The audit identified 12 independent Gradle wrapper roots and 22 active build.gradle files. GitNexus confirmed the racingcar module flow and test surfaces; targeted filesystem reads supplied precise Gradle and manifest line locations. Generated wrapper JAR/scripts may also be refreshed by the executor's wrapper command, but the version-bearing configuration locations are the 12 wrapper properties files listed here.

coverage_notes: GitNexus index coderetreat was available (192 files, 723 nodes, 1273 edges) and used for structure/usage discovery; exact configuration line ranges were verified with targeted reads because build manifests are represented primarily as file nodes. All settings.gradle files were inspected: dijkstra, movierental, bowlinggame, gameoflife, and stringcalculator include a java module; racingcar includes leaderboard, telemetrysystem, textconverter, tirepressuremonitoringsystem, and turnticketdispenser; other wrapper roots are single active source projects despite legacy placeholder includes/comments. No excluded paths. No external services were declared, and a targeted scan of repository-owned files found no database, search, broker, cache, Docker, host/port, or other service configuration. node_modules and historical *.patch files were excluded from findings. No direct Ramda source import was found. The Step 2a async/express/socket.io/uglify-js checklist does not apply to any requested direct dependency crossing a listed boundary. Repository git status could not be read because Git flagged dubious ownership; this did not reduce manifest/module coverage.
